purpose: Record the first declared post-baseline reopen trigger that is actually satisfied: an exact AMECO cyclically adjusted/structural primary-balance series for Romania plus official historical AMECO vintages. The trigger authorizes only a new preregistered measurement/vintage-materialisation and timing-adjudication cycle.
governing_reopen_rule: A separately preregistered cycle is justified by genuinely new measurement or identification evidence, such as a cyclically adjusted primary-balance vintage, longer real-time historical vintages or an independently justified regime/identification design.

current_ameco_database.chapter: Cyclical adjustment of public finance variables

exact_series.concept: Structural balance of general government excluding interest; adjustment based on potential GDP; excessive deficit procedure
exact_series.unit: Percentage of potential GDP at current prices

scientific_rationale: The previous annual fiscal form failed before its untouched 2018-2024 evaluation window was opened.
UBLGBPS changes the measurement boundary rather than respecifying the failed equation after observing its result.
Official release-specific AMECO archives make a real-time/vintage information-set analysis possible without backfilling later revisions into earlier decision dates.
The source evidence must be materialised and timing semantics adjudicated before any new structural-selection equation, window or sign/domain rule is preregistered.
next_gate: Materialise exact UBLGBPS rows from selected official AMECO releases with archive bytes, matched-row bytes, release metadata and SHA-256. Then perform a separate information-set/timing adjudication before any new structural-selection preregistration.
